notes: Facts apply to both the voltijd and deeltijd variants of the programme. The tuition amount is the one-off payment option; the page also offers 12 instalments of € 568, plus € 90 inschrijfgeld and circa € 315 book costs per year (not included). The two intake dates (2026-12-01 and 2027-04-01) are start dates at Amsterdam, Rotterdam and Utrecht for both voltijd and deeltijd; no application deadline is stated. The pages do not mention Studielink or any other application platform, so applicationChannel was left out. The page states Dutch-taught requirements only (HAVO/VWO/MBO 4); no language proficiency rule could be quoted. Requirements shown are the generic ones on this programme page.
